A Complete Overview of Yamuna Builder’s Finished Projects and What’s Next
Yamuna Builders
October 13, 2025
At
Yamuna Homes & Designs
we believe that every building we finish is a story. A story of craftsmanship, trust, location, design thinking and what living should be. Over the years, our completed residential complexes have turned visions into homes across Mangalore. Let us walk you through what we’ve delivered so far and what we are excited about next.
What We’ve Delivered: Our Completed Projects
Here are the eight completed residential complexes by Yamuna Homes & Designs. Each one shows how we combine design, location, amenities and living comfort.
Prakruthi, Yekkur, Mangalore
A mix of 1, 2 and 3 BHK apartments. Located in Yekkur, this project offers easy access to key parts of the city. It includes features such as two automatic lifts, solar water heater, rooftop party hall, gym and children’s play area.
Yamuna Paradise, Kottara Chowki, Mangalore
Luxury apartments with high-end finishes. Features include vitrified flooring, anti-skid tiles, glazed tile detailing in toilets and kitchen, decorative main entrance, ample power backup and aesthetic windows. Located close to schools, hospitals, shopping, making everyday life easier.
Yamuna Residency, Naguri, Mangalore
Emphasis on lifestyle and comfort. Blocks with multiple automatic lifts, generator backup, community amenities like swimming pool, gym, children’s play area, sizeable party halls. Strong structural design, quality in finishes and good orientation for privacy and visibility.
Ganga Yamuna, Lower Carstreet, Mangalore
2 and 3 BHK units, thoughtful utility provision, 24-hour water and power backup, fire safety through compliance, good interior details in kitchen and toilets, visitor lobbies, lift services. Proximity to city core is a big plus.
Yamuna Pride, Jeppinamogaru, Mangalore
2 and 3 BHK units with Vastu compliance, solar water heater, rooftop party hall, an automatic 10-passenger lift, intercom facility. Blend of elegance and usefulness.
Yamuna Garden, Mannagudda, Mangalore
One of our serene projects. Good landscaping, well laid-out road access, attention to external aesthetics and common spaces. Offers residents a balance of natural calm and urban access.
Yamuna Mathias Heights, Kapikad, Mangalore
Located in Kapikad. Designed for good living. Attention to specs: solar water heater, automatic generators, security, good quality flooring, designer windows, bathrooms with high grade fittings, fire safety.
Yamuna Asha City, Kulai
A gated community layout. Villas, plots, wide roads, parks, waterfront development, infrastructure for community living. Emphasis on green space, open areas, lifestyle amenities
What’s Coming Up: Projects in Progress
We are not stopping. Here are the ongoing projects we are working on to raise the bar:
Yamuna Sky City
in Kulai
A large tower offering 2, 3, 4 and 5 BHK apartments.
Sea-facing
views, triple height lobby, landscaped gardens, club house, high speed lifts, full power backup, advanced amenities. Scheduled for handover in 2028.
Yamuna Kamaldeep Twin Tower, Pumpwell
A landmark tower offering 2, 3, and 4 BHK apartments along with commercial spaces on Basement 1, Ground, and First Floors. Features include indoor games and recreation zone, fully equipped gym, spacious banquet hall, reading library, and second-floor clubhouse. Ongoing project.
Why These Matter to You
Here is what all this means if you are looking for a home or thinking long-term investment with us:
Every project has consistent quality. Structure, materials, finishes are carefully chosen to last. Amenities are not just for show they are useful.
Each location is chosen to balance peace and convenience. Whether you want calm or fast access to city services we aim to give both.
Variety matters. From 1BHK to 5BHK, apartments to villas to plots, we offer choices so you can, whatever your budget and need, find something that suits.
Forward thinking. Power backup, solar water heaters, fire safety, security, layout designs,  these are built-in considerations not afterthoughts.
To Sum Up
We are proud of the eight completed projects: Prakruthi, Yamuna Paradise, Yamuna Residency, Ganga Yamuna, Yamuna Pride, Yamuna Garden, Yamuna Mathias Heights, Yamuna’s Asha City. Each reflects who we are: thoughtful, quality-oriented and resident-focused.
Looking ahead
Yamuna Sky City
and Yamuna Kamaldeep Twin Tower show where we want real community living to move, more space, more amenities, sustainability, comfort.

# Yamuna Sky City Makes Its Debut at the India Property Show in Dubai

![Yamuna Builders](https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/a3dfc3a93d2b34cc07c6e140bfe4e60d1c6ac34fd0c38101094b733097227e46?s=40&d=mm&r=g)[Yamuna Builders](<https://yamunabuilders.com/author/yamunapagraphics/>) September 18, 2025

![](https://yamunabuilders.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/untitled-0-8.webp)

There are certain occasions in the life of a company that feel like turning points. For us at Yamuna Homes and Design Private Limited, the soft launch of Yamuna Sky City at the India Property Show in Dubai was one such occasion. To stand at The Ritz-Carlton, surrounded by an audience drawn from across the world, and to speak of a vision that has taken shape in Mangalore was as rewarding as it was humbling.  
This was not simply about unveiling another residential building. It was about telling a story, one that connects the timeless calm of the Arabian Sea with the expectations of modern living, and about sharing that story with people who understand what it means to belong both here and elsewhere.

## Introducing Yamuna Sky City

Kulai, where Yamuna Sky City rises, is a place of quiet promise. It is one of those neighbourhoods where the city meets the coast, where the sea is not a distant blue line but a constant companion. The tower has been designed to embrace this setting. Every apartment looks towards the water, every window invites the light and breeze that mark coastal life.  
We did not wish to create a residence that could be anywhere. We wanted to create a home that could only belong here. The interiors reflect this philosophy. They are modern yet calm, crafted with materials chosen as much for their quality as for their ability to endure. When you walk into these spaces, you feel the openness that comes from generous light and thoughtful design, rather than ornament for its own sake.

## A Life That Moves at Its Own Pace

There is a rhythm to living by the sea. It is slower, yet more refreshing. Yamuna Sky City seeks to bring that rhythm into daily life. The amenities are not there to impress at a glance but to support the way people genuinely live. There are places to relax, places to exercise, and places to gather, but always with an emphasis on comfort and simplicity.  
To us, a successful home is one that supports every stage of life. A child playing in the common areas, a professional returning to the quiet of an evening view, a family celebrating milestones together: Yamuna Sky City has been designed with all of this in mind.

## Kulai and Its Advantage

Every great residential development begins with its location. Kulai’s advantage is its balance. On one side lies the Arabian Sea, on the other a network of roads, schools, and healthcare institutions. Residents will never have to choose between the practical and the beautiful, for here both exist side by side.  
It is this blend that makes Kulai a natural choice for Yamuna Sky City. One might step out in the morning to catch a glimpse of the waves, and later in the day reach the centre of Mangalore with ease. Few neighbourhoods can promise so much with such little compromise.

## Why Dubai Was the Stage

![](data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D'http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg'%20viewBox%3D'0%200%20500%20500'%2F%3E)

Choosing Dubai for the soft launch was no accident. The city is a meeting place, a crossroads where aspirations from different cultures converge. More importantly, it is home to a large Indian community who, despite their success abroad, continue to hold strong ties to their towns and cities back home.  
At the India Property Show, we spoke with many such families. Their questions were not limited to price or floor plans. They asked what it would feel like to live there. Could they wake to the sound of the sea. Would their children have space to play. Could they return after years abroad and still feel at home. These are the questions that matter, and it was reassuring to see how naturally Yamuna Sky City provided the answers.

## More Than a Project

For Yamuna Homes and Design Private Limited, Yamuna Sky City represents more than a new development. It reflects the values we have always sought to uphold: integrity, reliability, and a belief that homes should be as enduring as the families who live in them.  
The positive response we received in Dubai affirmed that this philosophy resonates far beyond Mangalore. People recognise when a home has been created with care rather than haste, with intention rather than imitation. Yamuna Sky City is our attempt to build not just for today but for decades to come.

## Looking Ahead

The soft launch in Dubai is only the beginning of this journey. In the months ahead, more will be revealed about the details of Yamuna Sky City. Yet even at this stage, the essence is clear. It is a home shaped by its closeness to the sea, by the strength of its design, and by the trust that Yamuna Homes and Design has earned over the years.  
For those who dream of mornings filled with light and evenings framed by the horizon, for those who seek a home where modern comfort meets natural beauty, Yamuna Sky City offers that promise. It is not only another tower in Kulai but a landmark in the making, a place where the rhythm of coastal life and the needs of contemporary living come together.  
As we reflect on the launch in Dubai, we carry with us the conversations, the curiosity, and the enthusiasm of those who joined us. They reminded us that building is not simply about concrete and steel. It is about creating spaces that feel alive, where people can see their future unfolding. Yamuna Sky City is our contribution to that vision, and we are proud to share it.

## Project Highlights

###### **RERA Number:**

__Luxury Residential Tower

 __Kulai, Mangalore

 __Ongoing Project

Yamuna Sky City is a premier residential tower nestled in the heart of Kulai, Mangalore, offering an unparalleled blend of modern living and coastal beauty. Located just a stone’s throw away from the serene Arabian Sea, this residential complex provides an unmatched living experience. The development is a true testament to luxury, where residents can wake up to breathtaking sea views and enjoy the soothing sound of the waves every day.

Yamuna Sky City offers meticulously designed sea-facing apartments, each crafted with the finest materials and finishes to ensure maximum comfort and convenience. With state-of-theart amenities and a location that seamlessly blends nature and modern living, Yamuna Sky City redefines the essence of coastal luxury living.

## Modern Utilities and Solid Infrastructure

### Utilities and Infrastructure

  * High-speed automatic passenger lifts with digital control system (6 lifts).
  * Automatic service lifts (2 lifts).
  * 100% backup power through synchronised diesel generators with automatic changeover.
  * Water supply through underground sump tank and overhead tanks.
  * Raw water treatment plant and treated water for landscaping and flushing.
  * Corporation & open well water connections.

### Project Structure

  * Fully framed CC structure with garage facility in ground, 1st, and 2nd floors design.
  * RCC shear walls and solid block masonry for upper floors.
  * Waterproof external plastering with exterior anti-fungal emulsion paints.
  * Reticulated gas system for kitchens.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

### __Where is Yamuna Sky City located?

Yamuna Sky City is located in **Kulai, Mangalore** , just minutes away from the serene beaches of Mangalore, offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Sea.

### __What are the amenities offered in this project?

Yamuna Sky City offers a wide range of luxurious amenities, including:

  * Infinity Swimming Pool with panoramic sea views
  * Fully-equipped Gymnasium
  * Spa & Wellness Center
  * Multipurpose Sports Court
  * Children’s Play Area and Miyawaki Forest
  * Clubhouse, Banquet Hall, and Amphitheatre
  * Walking Track and Outdoor Games Area
  * 24/7 Security with CCTV surveillance
  * Family Park and Toddler Play Area

### __Is Yamuna Sky City a residential or commercial project?

Yamuna Sky City is a **residential project** , offering luxury 2BHK, 3BHK, 4BHK , & 5BHK apartments with premium finishes and state-of-the-art amenities.

### __What is the status of the Yamuna Sky City project?

The **Yamuna Sky City project** is **currently under construction** and is expected to be completed in **2028**. The development is progressing as per the planned timeline.

Yamuna Sky City is a premier residential tower nestled in the heart of Kulai, Mangalore, offering an unparalleled blend of modern living and coastal beauty. Located just a stone’s throw away from the serene Arabian Sea, this residential complex provides an unmatched living experience. The development is a true testament to luxury, where residents can wake up to breathtaking sea views and enjoy the soothing sound of the waves every day.
Yamuna Sky City offers meticulously designed sea-facing apartments, each crafted with the finest materials and finishes to ensure maximum comfort and convenience. With state-of-theart amenities and a location that seamlessly blends nature and modern living, Yamuna Sky City redefines the essence of coastal luxury living.

# Building Dreams

At Yamuna Homes & Design Pvt. Ltd., we specialize in creating innovative living spaces that blend luxury, functionality, and sustainability, shaping the future of modern communities.

ABOUT YAMUNA

## An Inspiring Journey from Roots to Remarkable Achievements

### 20

+

### Years

Yamuna Homes and Designs evolved from a small entity into a major player in the construction industry over the past two decades. We began with Yamuna Drilling Enterprises and Yamuna Earth Movers, and today, we are a trusted name in real estate, civil construction, and residential developments across India, especially in Karnataka.

### Urban Living

Our focus is to provide state-of-the-art living spaces and quality commercial developments that elevate the standards of urban life. Our signature projects, such as Yamuna Asha City and Yamuna Sky City, define the future of luxurious and sustainable living.

![](data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D'http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg'%20viewBox%3D'0%200%20128%20128'%2F%3E)

### Our Approach

Founded in 1993, Yamuna Homes and Design began as a small venture providing specialized [services](<https://yamunabuilders.com/other-services/>) in digging tube wells and earth-moving through our sister concerns, Yamuna Drilling Enterprises and Yamuna Earth Movers. Over the years, we have expanded our operations and diversified into the real estate and construction sectors, delivering landmark projects across the state of Karnataka.

![](data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D'http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg'%20viewBox%3D'0%200%20128%20128'%2F%3E)

### Our Vision

Our vision is to redefine the real estate landscape of India by developing world-class residential, commercial, and hospitality projects that meet international standards. We aspire to contribute to the sustainable development of the country by positioning ourselves at the forefront of the ever-evolving real estate and construction industries, fostering innovation and excellence consistently.

![](data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D'http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg'%20viewBox%3D'0%200%20128%20128'%2F%3E)

### Our Mission

We believe in a collaborative approach to construction, where the client’s needs and aspirations are at the forefront of every project. Our [dedicated team](<https://yamunabuilders.com/about/>) of architects, engineers, designers, and construction professionals work closely to bring visions to life, ensuring that each project is completed on time, within budget, to the highest standards, and with unmatched precision and innovative design solutions.

![](data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D'http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg'%20viewBox%3D'0%200%20128%20128'%2F%3E)

### Our Journey

At Yamuna Homes and Design, we are dedicated to developing high-quality residential and commercial properties that enrich the lives of our customers.

At Yamuna Homes and Design, we are committed to developing high-quality residential and commercial properties that enrich our customers' lives by providing superior spaces that blend modernity, functionality, and sustainability, offering innovative designs and construction techniques, ensuring timely project completion, and fostering long-term client relationships based on trust and reliability.

  * Superior Spaces
  * Innovative Designs
  * Timely Delivery
  * Client Relationships

![](data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D'http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg'%20viewBox%3D'0%200%20128%20128'%2F%3E)

## Our Values

We uphold values of quality, innovation, sustainability, and customer satisfaction, ensuring every project reflects excellence, eco-consciousness, and client-focused dedication.

At Yamuna Homes and Design, we deliver projects meeting the highest quality standards for durability, aesthetics, and sustainability. Embracing innovation, we adopt the latest construction techniques and technologies. We prioritize sustainability through responsible practices, minimizing our ecological footprint. Customer satisfaction is our priority, ensuring their needs are met throughout the project.

ABOUT THE PROMOTER

## A Legacy of Excellence in Real Estate

![Purushotham R Shetty \(Managing Director\)](data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D'http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg'%20viewBox%3D'0%200%20600%20621'%2F%3E)

## Purushotham R Shetty

Managing Director

At the helm of Yamuna Homes and Design is Purushotham R Shetty, a visionary entrepreneur and real estate expert. With over two decades of experience in the construction and real estate sectors, he leads the company with a focus on innovation, sustainability, and quality.

His leadership has been instrumental in establishing Yamuna Homes and Design as a trusted name in the industry, committed to delivering projects that exceed client expectations.

WHY CHOOSE YAMUNA

## Building Trust Through Quality and Excellence

![](https://yamunabuilders.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/ezgif-2-148434ff7b.gif.webp)

### Client-Focused

We prioritize clients, ensuring satisfaction with clear communication and tailored solutions.

![](https://yamunabuilders.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/ezgif-2-e78b400074.gif.webp)

### Timely Delivery

We deliver projects on time, maintaining quality and excellence while meeting deadlines.

![](https://yamunabuilders.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/ezgif-2-9a2381324d.gif.webp)

### Eco-Friendly

We use eco-friendly methods, creating functional spaces with minimal environmental impact.

![](https://yamunabuilders.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/ezgif-2-91ecb03748.gif.webp)

### Innovation

We embrace new technologies and trends, delivering cutting-edge solutions to our clients.

## Building Trust, Quality, Dreams, Success, and Excellence.

Yamuna Homes and Design Pvt. Ltd. delivers innovative, sustainable, and high-quality spaces, shaping modern lifestyles and transforming real estate across Karnataka since 1993, with integrity, expertise, and unmatched customer satisfaction.

# Ground Experts

From earth moving to advanced drilling, we provide reliable and efficient solutions for residential and commercial projects, ensuring timely and cost-effective results.

OTHER SERVICES

## From Solid Foundations to Boundless Horizons

# Yamuna Earth Movers

We provide comprehensive Earth Moving Services, tailored to meet the needs of both residential and commercial projects. With advanced equipment and a highly skilled workforce, we are able to complete projects on time and within budget.

  * Land Clearing and Excavation
  * Site Grading and Leveling
  * Soil Compaction and Stabilization
  * Trenching and Backfilling
  * Material Hauling and Disposal

[CONTACT US](<https://yamunabuilders.com/contact/>)

# Yamuna Drilling

Our Drilling Services are designed to meet the needs of both residential and industrial projects. We specialize in a wide range of drilling services, from water well drilling to piling for large-scale construction projects.

  * Water Well Drilling
  * Borewell Drilling
  * Piling Services
  * Soil Investigation Drilling
  * Horizontal Directional Drilling (HDD)
  * Geotechnical Drilling

[CONTACT US](<https://yamunabuilders.com/contact/>)

## WHERE THIS PROJECT IS?

Yamuna Sky City is strategically located in Kulai, New Mangalore, Karnataka, offering a perfect balance between coastal serenity and urban connectivity. Situated just a short distance from the Arabian Sea, the project enjoys a premium seaside setting while remaining well-connected to key parts of the city. The development lies along the NH-66 corridor, ensuring smooth accessibility to Mangalore city center and surrounding regions. Important landmarks such as Mangalore International Airport (approx. 12 km), Surathkal Railway Station (around 4 km), and NIT Karnataka are all within close proximity, making daily commuting and travel highly convenient.

## ELEVATED LIVING, ENGINEERED TO PERFECTION

  * The development boasts a soaring 60-story tower housing 299 meticulously crafted flats, complemented by an elevated podium featuring three levels of parking.
  * A grandiose triple-height entrance lobby and welcoming visitors lounge set the tone for an elevated living experience.
  * The building is facilitated by six high-speed automatic lifts, each accommodating 20 passengers, alongside two 24-passenger service lifts (Mitsubishi or equivalent).
  * Strict adherence to Fire Service Department specifications ensures fire fighting systems throughout the premises.
  * Uninterrupted power supply is guaranteed via a 100% backup system, featuring an acoustically enclosed generator for seamless operations.
  * Enhanced security measures, including electronic surveillance cameras and round-the-clock personnel, ensure the safety of residents.
  * Multi-video door phone connectivity offers direct communication between security personnel and individual apartments, enhancing convenience and security.
  * Sustainable water management solutions, such as rainwater harvesting and borewell facilities supplemented by corporation water, underscore the project’s commitment to environmental stewardship.
  * The installation of a Water Treatment Plant (WTP) and Sewerage Treatment Plant (STP) ensures the availability of clean water for domestic use and the responsible treatment of wastewater.
  * Advanced waste management technologies, including Bio Organic Waste Convertor (OWC) equipment, contribute to the project’s eco-friendly ethos.

  * Residents enjoy a plethora of recreational amenities, including a Ground floor leisure zone featuring a jogging track, skating rink, and cricket pitch, as well as a dedicated children’s play area.
  * Ample visitors parking facilities are conveniently situated on the ground floor, facilitating hassle-free guest access.
  * Common facilities on the ground floor include a society room, as well as dedicated rooms for Building Management System (BMS) and CCTV operations.
  * Tranquil shaded seating areas, thoughtfully integrated amidst lush landscaped gardens and water features on the ground floor, offer residents of all ages a serene retreat.
  * The first and second floors cater to the needs of support staff, with dedicated drivers/servants rooms featuring attached facilities, alongside common dining areas and separate toilet blocks for both genders.
  * The third floor hosts an opulent infinity swimming pool, a separate kids’ pool, and a versatile multipurpose court, adding a touch of luxury to the residents’ leisure pursuits.
  * Host events in style at our 3rd-floor banquet hall, complete with separate restrooms.
  * Dive into luxury at our 61st-floor infinity pool with stunning panoramic views.
  * Go green with solar panels on the terrace, adding eco-friendly charm to our property.
  * Get a unique view from our viewing gallery at the LMR bottom level.

## WHO ARE INVOLVED

WIND ENGINEERING CONSULTANTS

#### CPP WIND ENGINEERING CONSULTANTS, AUSTRALIA

CPP Wind Engineering Consultants fosters an inclusive culture built on integrity, respect, and collaboration. Guided by the legacy of its founders, the company focuses on continuous growth, learning, and applying expertise to deliver innovative solutions for a safe, sustainable, and resilient built environment.

In partnership with clients, CPP combines global expertise with a forward-thinking approach to address current challenges while embracing future opportunities. It provides an environment where talent thrives—benefiting its people, clients, and society.

EXPERTISE & CAPABILITIES

CPP’s global team comprises industry-leading experts recognized for innovation and technical excellence. With laboratory facilities in the USA (Windsor, Colorado), Australia (Sydney), and Malaysia (Kuala Lumpur), the company delivers responsive consulting services across Australasia, Asia, the Middle East, and Europe.

CPP operates four recirculating boundary-layer wind tunnels across three facilities, supported by advanced in-house model design, 3D printing, CNC fabrication, and high-performance computing clusters for CFD and simulation—ensuring precise, efficient, and high-quality results.

Close-up photographs of the completed model in the wind tunnel

![](data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D'http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg'%20viewBox%3D'0%200%20789%20589'%2F%3E)

Kuala Lumpar, Malaysia

ABL wind tunnels simulate how wind behaves around buildings, accounting for changes in speed and turbulence with height, as well as the impact of terrain and surroundings. They also allow testing from multiple wind directions.

![](data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D'http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg'%20viewBox%3D'0%200%20784%20589'%2F%3E)

Sydney, Australia

Why They’re Large

Tunnel size is critical for accuracy. Models must be large enough for precise pressure measurement while maintaining realistic wind conditions, typically scaled 250–500 times smaller than actual structures.

Adjustable elements recreate real-world wind flow, ensuring reliable results. Despite advances in CFD, wind tunnel testing remains the most accurate method for analysis.

STRUCTURAL CONSULTANT

#### SHANGHVI AND ASSOCIATES CONSULTANTS PRIVATE LIMITED

With over 50 years of excellence, we deliver innovative, sustainable, and cost-effective structural engineering solutions across India and beyond. As a passionate team of experts, we transform ideas into reality through advanced design, seamless project management, and cutting-edge BIM and digital solutions. Backed by global standards, rigorous quality reviews, and a legacy of engineering achievements, we ensure every project is executed with precision, reliability, and lasting impact.

ALUMINIUM FORMWORK

#### MFE FORMWORK (MIVAN) MALAYSIA

MFE Formwork Technology is a global leader in aluminium formwork systems, founded in 1991 in Malaysia as Mivan Far East. The company pioneered the commercialization of aluminium formwork for monolithic construction, enabling faster, cost-efficient, and high-quality building solutions. Over the years, MFE has expanded its presence to more than 50 countries, delivering over 2,500 projects and becoming a trusted partner in large-scale residential and commercial developments. Key milestones include its 2007 management buyout and rebranding to MFE, the establishment of a large global headquarters and manufacturing hub in Kuala Lumpur in 2015, and its 2024 acquisition by Doka, marking a new phase of global growth and innovation.

## Project Highlights

###### **RERA Number:**  
PRM/KA/RERA/1257/334 /PR/171023/006331

__Luxury Residential Tower

 __Kulai, Mangalore

 __Ongoing Project

[Yamuna Sky City](<https://yamunabuilders.com/yamuna-sky-city/>) is a premier residential tower in Kulai, Mangalore, offering the perfect mix of modern living and coastal charm. Just steps away from the Arabian Sea, this development is ideal for anyone seeking a sea facing apartment in Karnataka. Wake up to breathtaking views, the calming sound of waves, and the comfort of a home designed for luxury.

Each apartment is carefully planned with premium finishes and smart layouts to maximize space and comfort. With state of the art amenities and a setting that blends natural beauty with urban convenience, Yamuna Sky City sets a new benchmark for coastal living in Karnataka.

[VIEW BROCHURE](<https://yamunabuilders.com/sky-city-brochure/>)

BUILT FOR COMFORT

## Modern Utilities and Solid Infrastructure

### Utilities and Infrastructure

  * High-speed automatic passenger lifts with digital control system (6 lifts).
  * Automatic service lifts (2 lifts).
  * 100% backup power through synchronised diesel generators with automatic changeover.
  * Water supply through underground sump tank and overhead tanks.
  * Raw water treatment plant and treated water for landscaping and flushing.
  * Corporation & open well water connections.

### Project Structure

  * Fully framed CC structure with garage facility in ground, 1st, and 2nd floors design.
  * RCC shear walls and solid block masonry for upper floors.
  * Waterproof external plastering with exterior anti-fungal emulsion paints.
  * Reticulated gas system for kitchens.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

### __Where is Yamuna Sky City located?

Yamuna Sky City is located in **Kulai, Mangalore** , just minutes away from the serene beaches of Mangalore, offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Sea.

### __What are the amenities offered in this project?

Yamuna Sky City offers a wide range of luxurious amenities, including:

  * Infinity Swimming Pool with panoramic sea views
  * Fully-equipped Gymnasium
  * Spa & Wellness Center
  * Multipurpose Sports Court
  * Children’s Play Area and Miyawaki Forest
  * Clubhouse, Banquet Hall, and Amphitheatre
  * Walking Track and Outdoor Games Area
  * 24/7 Security with CCTV surveillance
  * Family Park and Toddler Play Area

### __Is Yamuna Sky City a residential or commercial project?

Yamuna Sky City is a **residential project** , offering luxury 2BHK, 3BHK, 4BHK , & 5BHK apartments with premium finishes and state-of-the-art amenities.

### __What is the status of the Yamuna Sky City project?

The **Yamuna Sky City project** is **currently under construction** and is expected to be completed in **2028**. The development is progressing as per the planned timeline.

## Elegant Design, Premium Amenities, Seamless Living

### Premium Common Area Features

Experience luxury with elegant triple-height lobbies, premium finishes, vibrant recreational spaces, a podium-level pool, landscaped gardens, and thoughtfully designed amenities for comfort, leisure, and entertainment.

  * Triple-height entrance lobby/reception for an elegant first impression.
  * Granite and marble flooring for corridors and staircases.
  * Outdoor multi-court for sports and games.
  * Amphitheatre for entertainment and events.
  * Spacious kids’ play area.
  * Swimming pool and landscaped gardens at the podium level (3rd floor).
  * Visitor parking on the ground floor.

### Utilities and Infrastructure

State-of-the-art utilities include high-speed lifts, 100% power backup, advanced water treatment, and reliable water supply systems, ensuring seamless functionality and convenience for residents and businesses.

  * High-speed automatic passenger lifts with digital control system (6 lifts).
  * Automatic service lifts (2 lifts).
  * 100% backup power through synchronised diesel generators with automatic changeover.
  * Water supply through underground sump tank and overhead tanks.
  * Raw water treatment plant and treated water for landscaping and flushing.
  * Corporation & open well water connections.

WHY CHOOSE US

## Prime Location, Luxury, and Affordability

### Unbeatable Location

Located just minutes away from the pristine beaches of Mangalore, enjoy uninterrupted views of the Arabian Sea from the comfort of your home.

### Luxurious Amenities

Yamuna Sky City offers an array of luxurious amenities designed to elevate your lifestyle, including a fitness center, swimming pool, spa, and outdoor recreational spaces.

### Beachfront Living

Experience the serenity of seaside living while enjoying the convenience and modern comforts of a contemporary urban lifestyle.

### Affordable Homes

Whether you are looking for a 1BHK, 2BHK, or 3BHK apartment, Yamuna Sky City offers exclusive homes that are designed to suit your lifestyle and budget.

# Yamuna Builders

Yamuna Builders (Yamuna Homes & Design Pvt. Ltd.) was established with a vision to redefine the real estate landscape of Karnataka by setting uncompromising standards for quality. With a foundational journey that began in 1993 through specialized drilling and earth-moving enterprises, the company brings decades of deep, ground-up expertise to every project. Under the leadership of Managing Director Purushotham R. Shetty, Yamuna Builders witnessed how a lack of integrity and transparency in the sector could compromise a client's trust and investment. Driven by a commitment to innovation, sustainability, and excellence, the company built its reputation on closing the gap between a developer's promise and the final delivery. Their approach ensures that every client can invest in world-class residential and commercial developments, like the landmark Yamuna Sky City, with complete confidence, knowing their home is not only a functional, luxurious space but also a reliable, high-quality asset.

Yamuna Builders
Yamuna Builders (Yamuna Homes & Design Pvt. Ltd.) was established with a vision to redefine the real estate landscape of Karnataka by setting uncompromising standards for quality. With a foundational journey that began in 1993 through specialized drilling and earth-moving enterprises, the company brings decades of deep, ground-up expertise to every project.

Under the leadership of Managing Director Purushotham R. Shetty, Yamuna Builders witnessed how a lack of integrity and transparency in the sector could compromise a client's trust and investment. Driven by a commitment to innovation, sustainability, and excellence, the company built its reputation on closing the gap between a developer's promise and the final delivery.

Their approach ensures that every client can invest in world-class residential and commercial developments, like the landmark Yamuna Sky City, with complete confidence, knowing their home is not only a functional, luxurious space but also a reliable, high-quality asset.

# Yamuna Builders

Yamuna Builders (Yamuna Homes & Design Pvt. Ltd.) was established with a vision to redefine the real estate landscape of Karnataka by setting uncompromising standards for quality. With a foundational journey that began in 1993 through specialized drilling and earth-moving enterprises, the company brings decades of deep, ground-up expertise to every project. Under the leadership of Managing Director Purushotham R. Shetty, Yamuna Builders witnessed how a lack of integrity and transparency in the sector could compromise a client's trust and investment. Driven by a commitment to innovation, sustainability, and excellence, the company built its reputation on closing the gap between a developer's promise and the final delivery. Their approach ensures that every client can invest in world-class residential and commercial developments, like the landmark Yamuna Sky City, with complete confidence, knowing their home is not only a functional, luxurious space but also a reliable, high-quality asset.

Yamuna Builders
Yamuna Builders (Yamuna Homes & Design Pvt. Ltd.) was established with a vision to redefine the real estate landscape of Karnataka by setting uncompromising standards for quality. With a foundational journey that began in 1993 through specialized drilling and earth-moving enterprises, the company brings decades of deep, ground-up expertise to every project.

Under the leadership of Managing Director Purushotham R. Shetty, Yamuna Builders witnessed how a lack of integrity and transparency in the sector could compromise a client's trust and investment. Driven by a commitment to innovation, sustainability, and excellence, the company built its reputation on closing the gap between a developer's promise and the final delivery.

Their approach ensures that every client can invest in world-class residential and commercial developments, like the landmark Yamuna Sky City, with complete confidence, knowing their home is not only a functional, luxurious space but also a reliable, high-quality asset.
